title: 1619 Prairie's card no longer claims a picture of it
items: 1619 Prairie was marked as pictured on the 1886 Hamline and Farwell drawing. That plate shows only the edge of the house standing there in 1886, which the four-storey stone front of 1904 replaced. The card now grades the house as known from maps, and the drawing's side-by-side is kept on record.
